recipe: Repeat decoded LSF frames and q/scale blocks twice; repack exact modes with continuous decoder state. This is an 8-second workload, not a new independent quality reference or a reset at the join.

profiles.instrumentation: Decode wall intervals include active IRQ and flag stores; PB0 marks OCR2B writes; queue sampled every 160 ticks.
